description: New and Discontinued Price Symbol Alerts are issued when we launch new assessments and announce discontinued assessments.

Subscriber Notes inform you of upcoming changes related to the markets that we report on, as well as requests for comment on new assessments, and announcements that assessments will be discontinued. Subscriber Notes can be received by Commodity Region, and Note Type.
